2A)                In a dihybrid cross between pea plants, you studied the inheritance of seed shape (round, R; wrinkled, r) and seed color (3)  
  (yellow, Y; green, y). You crossed plants heterozygous for both traits (RrYy) with each other. The following phenotypic  
  ratio was obtained - You got a ratio of Round Yellow :Wrinkled green : Round green: Wrinkled yellow 9:1:3:3  
  a) Construct a Punnett square to represent this cross.  
  b) What you can predict from the results?  
  c) What are the possible genotypes of Wrinkled yellow?  
  (1+1+1 = 3 marks)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2B)                Analyse the following pedigree chart:                                                                                       (3)

i) Predict the best possible mode of inheritance? Justify?  
  ii) Predict the genotype of elderly male and female.  
  iii) Calculate the probability of the third child being expressing the character for couples A and B.  
  (1+1+1 = 3 marks)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2C)                                                                                                                                                  (4)  
  
  
  To study the inheritance patterns of these traits, the scientist performs a dihybrid test cross between a plant heterozygous for both traits  
  (AaBb) and a plant homozygous recessive for both traits (aabb). The offspring display the following phenotypes and numbers:  
  • Red flowers, rounded leaves: 40  
  • Red flowers, jagged leaves: 10  
  • White flowers, rounded leaves: 12  
  • White flowers, jagged leaves: 38  
  i) Exhibit the cross in the form of a Punnett square.  
  ii) Identify the parental and recombinant phenotypes.  
  iii) Calculate the recombination frequency for these genes (factors).  
  iv) Based on your calculations, determine whether these genes are likely linked or assort independently.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"
